paper.title: Neural Contextual Bandits with UCB-based Exploration

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic K-armed contextual bandit with bounded unknown reward function (neural / NTK analysis)
unmapped: Each round presents K context feature vectors x_{t,a} in R^d; reward r = h(x_{t,a}) + xi_t with unknown h in [0,1] (no parametric assumption); context sequence arbitrary, regret bounds depend on NTK Gram matrix of all TK contexts
settings.definition_quote: We consider the stochastic $K$-armed contextual bandit problem, where the total number of rounds $T$ is known. ... $r_{t,a_t} = h(\xb_{t,a_t}) + \xi_t$, where $h$ is an unknown function satisfying $0 \leq h(\xb) \leq 1$ for any $\xb$, and $\xi_t$ is $\nu$-sub-Gaussian noise conditioned on $\xb_{1,a_1},\dots,\xb_{t-1,a_{t-1}}$ satisfying $\EE \xi_t = 0$.

symbols.d_eff: effective dimension of the NTK matrix, log det(I + H/lambda) / log(1 + TK/lambda)
symbols.J: number of gradient descent steps in TrainNN

conditions: Assumption 2: NTK matrix H >= lambda_0 I on all TK contexts, ||x||_2 = 1 and [x]_j = [x]_{j+d/2}

source.label: thm:newalgorithm
source.quote: Let $\tilde d$ be the effective dimension, and $\hb = [h(\xb^i)]_{i=1}^{TK} \in \RR^{TK}$. There exist constant $C_1, C_2>0$, such that for any $\delta \in(0,1)$, if $m \geq \text{poly}(T, L, K, \lambda^{-1}, \lambda_0^{-1}, S^{-1}, \log(1/\delta))$, $\eta = C_1( mTL + m \lambda)^{-1}$, $\lambda \geq \max\{1, S^{-2}\}$, and $S \geq \sqrt{2\hb^\top\Hb^{-1}\hb}$, then with probability at least $1-\delta$, the regret of Algorithm 1 satisfies R_T \leq 3\sqrt{T}\sqrt{\tilde d \log (1+TK/\lambda) + 2} \cdot [...] + 1.

results.notes: Paper's statement contains a typo '+ +'. Regret is sum of h(x*)-h(x_t) holding w.p. 1-delta. Remark 7: with J = O~(TL/lambda) optimization term <= sqrt(lambda) S; Remark 8 gives O~(sqrt(d_eff T) sqrt(max{d_eff, h^T H^{-1} h})), i.e. O~(d_eff sqrt(T)) overall. d_eff here is the paper's log-det effective dimension, not trace-based. Compute not stated though per-round cost is polynomial in p.

symbols.d_eff: effective dimension of the NTK matrix, log det(I + H/lambda) / log(1 + TK/lambda)
symbols.J: number of gradient descent steps in TrainNN

conditions: Assumption 2: NTK matrix H >= lambda_0 I on all TK contexts, ||x||_2 = 1 and [x]_j = [x]_{j+d/2}
tuning: m >= poly(T, L, K, 1/lambda, 1/lambda_0, 1/S, log T)

source.label: coro:expectation
source.quote: Under the same conditions in Theorem \ref{thm:newalgorithm}, there exists a positive constant $C$ such that \EE [R_T] \leq 2+3\sqrt{T}\sqrt{\tilde d \log (1+TK/\lambda) + 2}\cdot\bigg[\nu\sqrt{\tilde d \log (1+TK/\lambda) + 2+2\log T} + 2\sqrt{\lambda}S + (\lambda + CTL)(1- \lambda/(TL))^{J/2} \sqrt{T/\lambda}\bigg].

results.notes: Obtained from Theorem 5 with delta = 1/T. Expectation also over random network initialization; regret defined via mean rewards, so pseudo-regret.
